_about: The artefacts' in-match hints as the artefacts now are (artefacts-1.json, client patch 54; docs/notes/artefacts.md). A pickup hint (data/pickup_hint) says the passive, an activation hint (data/activation_hint) the active; fixed sentences, nothing computed from the config, and the artefacts have no lobby card (ui_desc's name and description keys have no text, props_list is empty). Spring's pickup hint: movement speed 2 % -> 5 % and aiming speed 5 % (passive/aim_time_mod -0.05; the gloves' texts call aim time 'aiming speed'); German already said 5 %. Its activation hint: aiming with the movement speed (+10 %, German's total +15 %), and bullets do not slow you (active/stopping_power_mod -1). Lifebone's activation hint: health restored (patch 54 fills pain, body and head); its pickup hint ('increases health regeneration') stays. Onyx's numbers were stock mistakes: passive 10 % (German 'auf 15 %') -> 5 % (damage_mul 0.95), active 95 % (German 'auf 90 %') -> 90 % (damage_mul 0.1; passive and active never both). The pickup hints' 'Onyx artifact.' / 'Артефакт Онікс.' openings, which the maps tab and the damage calculator read the names from, stay. Six localization tables each.
